scope: Refresh the open-source ACIS/SAB comparator inventory using an exact current cq-acis release artifact, profile-specific parser source, distribution provenance, and corpus/source-lineage evidence; refine existing gates without changing implementation or support claims.

method.kind: Primary-source web review of PyPI release metadata and attestations, immutable cq-acis source/docs, ezdxf documentation, NIST corpus metadata, and existing local ACIS plan records
method.evidenceBoundary: The release artifact and source pin establish reproducible candidate availability and documented parser scope, not behavior on any target sample. Existing cq-acis 0.3.8 run observations remain historical and were not repeated.

evidence.topic: cq-acis 0.3.11 distribution, platform, and artifact provenance
evidence.observed: PyPI records cq-acis 0.3.11 released on 2026-10-11 with Trusted Publishing provenance from GitHub Actions and the pinned repository commit c460afe89ab66820536220bc4e3e9805c3fb5e43. Wheels are listed for Windows x86-64, Linux manylinux/glibc x86-64 and ARM64, macOS ARM64 and x86-64. The macOS ARM64 wheel SHA-256 is 6dacb5d8372b10d9c2d4f973bee470c0c85dec49b4fd43013b81f159bd35d86; Windows x86-64 is 5647b00e3b00c0aa0d4826802c883ec0a3dff64371f5ea63b16e68086f3c2e0a; Linux x86-64 is 7ce8de3391855e145fb49ce624087c1ac73df16b76d9239b8cb1a279e58acd08; Linux ARM64 is 4862e8d4e971c47ed16f2801033d470579240e23750cc7ec2bca1957a9b3d41d; macOS x86-64 is 83fa9c33963452073a9d9d6fd9dd449785d98bf908974184ff69c7f40a23d21e. Package metadata requires Python 3.11+ and the README lists CadQuery 2.8+ as a dependency.
doesNotEstablish: that any wheel was downloaded, installed, or executed in this review
that an available wheel will accept or decode a particular SAB schema
that the package's OCCT-derived shape path is independent of FreeCAD/OCCT kernels
that dependency installation is cheap enough for leaf tests
evidence.planUse: For one optional composed comparison, pin the exact platform wheel by PyPI SHA-256 and verify its publishing attestation/source commit, Python version, and complete dependency lock in an isolated environment. A prebuilt wheel avoids Rust compilation but does not remove CadQuery/OCCT runtime and dependency cost.

evidence.topic: Exact SAB/ASM profile admission and parser completeness boundaries
evidence.observed: The pinned parser admits ACIS BinaryFile save version 21800 and ASM BinaryFile4 save versions 22000, 22300, 22600, 22700, 22900, and 23200. ASM BinaryFile8 has synthetic framing coverage only. Input, record, token, individual string, and nested subtype-depth limits exist. Unsupported record schemas can remain raw with diagnostics; history is retained as an opaque suffix. Source review shows the declared record_count is stored but not compared with the parsed active record total at EOF, and no cumulative retained-string budget is present.
doesNotEstablish: that the peer's profile boundaries are normative ACIS rules
that a successful framing parse implies all required body records were semantically decoded
that opaque history framing or DWG AcDs linkage is validated
that the peer's omitted count/aggregate-budget checks are defects in libdxfrw
evidence.planUse: Keep local SAB resource and completeness controls in existing 7S.3 owners. Use peer limits as an audit checklist, not numeric values to copy. Require no unsupported required topology, active-reference closure, complete requested-body conversion, and analytic expectations for a narrow semantic comparison.

evidence.topic: Numeric save version versus ACadSharp sample modeler stamp
evidence.observed: The existing local 3D plan records the three exact ACadSharp sample SABs as save_version 21800 with the distinct modeler stamp ASM 230.7.0.65535 NT; cq-acis 0.3.8 previously retained unsupported schema data at byte 235 and did not construct geometry. The pinned 0.3.11 parser admits save_version 21800, so prior 0.3.8 schema failure does not prove that 0.3.11 rejects the SAB container or has identical schema coverage.
doesNotEstablish: that 0.3.11 decodes the exact three sample payloads
that the AutoCAD modeler version string is the numeric SAB save version
the original authoring dimensions or unit interpretation
the DWG DataStorage owner, prototype relationship, or history lifecycle
evidence.planUse: At a single composed checkpoint only, re-run the exact existing payload hashes with cq-acis 0.3.11 and report header fields, raw/unsupported records, full body-reference coverage, conversion, and analytic outcomes independently. If exact payload hashes are not available, record NOT RUN. Keep the historical 0.3.8 result scoped to that release.

evidence.topic: Corpus provenance and independent reference lineage
evidence.observed: cq-acis's pinned corpus describes source commit/blob pins, per-file hashes, and license notices for inputs including legacy NIST SAT and ezdxf-generated cases. NIST describes its engineering-model collection as-is and notes that some files may be missing or fail in modern CAD. The pinned cq-acis parser source cites ezdxf tag grammar and cadmpeg format notes; cq-acis and cadmpeg are distinct GitHub projects, but this explicit source relationship means their dialect assumptions are not fully uncorrelated. A deeper contributor/authorship relationship was not established in this review. cq-acis shape conversion uses CadQuery/OpenCascade.
doesNotEstablish: a source-native AutoCAD AC1027 producer for the target payloads
known native dimensions/mass properties for each corpus model
fully independent format assumptions between cq-acis and cadmpeg
a second independent B-rep kernel from OCCT-based shape conversion
evidence.planUse: Track producer, parser implementation, consulted grammar/reference, corpus origin, geometry kernel, and consumer separately. Use the corpus as optional parser-stress data with per-file provenance/licensing, not as a known-dimension AutoCAD semantic witness.

evidence.observed: The ezdxf 1.4.4 ACIS API page documents load and export_sat/export_sab functions, while its FAQ says the package writes SAT only. The API also says its geometry tools understand only a limited subset, mesh_from_body extracts only flat polygonal faces, and the project has no ACIS kernel.
doesNotEstablish: which documentation statement matches a particular installed wheel's behavior
general SAT/SAB B-rep validity or arbitrary data round-trip
curved-surface meshing, DWG AcDs association, or source dimensions
evidence.planUse: Resolve SAB writer behavior with an exact-version local runtime probe before using ezdxf as a writer comparator. Keep planar mesh results limited to planar-face checks and do not infer curved-solid semantics.

nextActions: Keep cq-acis and cadmpeg out of per-slice dependencies; local generated fast tests remain the implementation gate.
At the composed external ACIS gate, pin cq-acis 0.3.11 source commit, exact platform wheel SHA-256/attestation, Python/platform and dependency lock.
Retest the exact existing ACadSharp SAB hashes only if available; distinguish save version 21800 from the modeler stamp, schema diagnostics, raw retention, body completeness and shape conversion.
Keep DWG AcDs DataStorage/key/owner/history closure separate from extracted SAB parser or geometry results.
Keep producer-native dimensions/units and a non-OCCT reader/kernel or native application as separate qualification dependencies.
